meta.name: abp-testing
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) testing quick reference: integration tests, *TestBase, SQLite in-memory, Shouldly, NSubstitute, data seeding, CurrentUser/CurrentTenant.Change. Use when you need to write tests in ABP.

copy.tagline: 快速编写 ABP 框架集成测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在 ABP 框架中编写测试
copy.tagline_en: Write integration tests quickly for ABP Framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write tests in ABP

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你编写 ABP v10.x 的测试：集成测试、SQLite 内存数据库、Shouldly 断言、NSubstitute 模拟、数据种子、用户/租户切换。遵循 AAA 模式，使用 *TestBase 基类。
howto.when: 当你说出“ABP test”、“integration test”、“TestBase”等关键词，或要求编写 ABP 测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 ABP 集成测试，创建一本新书。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Shouldly 断言的测试代码。

say.text: 在测试中模拟 IEmailSender 服务。
say.note: Claude 会使用 NSubstitute 添加模拟服务。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you write ABP v10.x tests: integration tests, SQLite in-memory DB, Shouldly assertions, NSubstitute mocking, data seeding, user/tenant switching. Uses AAA pattern and *TestBase classes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'ABP test', 'integration test', 'TestBase', etc., or ask to write ABP tests.

say_en.text: Write an ABP integration test to create a new book.
say_en.note: Claude generates test code with Shouldly assertions.

say_en.text: Mock the IEmailSender service in the test.
say_en.note: Claude uses NSubstitute to add the mock service.
